question: Who won the title of "ICC Men's Test Cricketer of the Decade" in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Steve Smith**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Steve Smith won the **"ICC Men's Test Cricketer of the Decade"** award in December 2020.
 
• This **award was based on his exceptional performances in Test cricket during the decade (2011–2020).**
 
• Smith was th**e leading run-scorer in Tests during this period, with a phenomenal batting average and several match-winning performances**.
 
• Steve Smith was the most consistent Test batsman of the decade, amassing over **7,000 Test runs** during this period with an average of nearly **65**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cricket World Cup is an international cricket championship held at four-year intervals. 
 
• It is the premier contest in one-day cricket and one of the most-watched sporting events in the world.
 
• In 1975 the first Cricket World Cup was contested in England as a series of one-day matches of 60 overs per side.
 
• It was held outside England, in India and Pakistan, for the first time in 1987.
 
• The 1987 contest also saw the number of overs per side reduced to 50. 
 
• In 2007 Australia became the first team to win three consecutive World Cup tournaments.
